notes.title: Rolling Back: Doodle Placement Precision Update Reversed Due to Technical Glitch
notes.notes: Regrettably, we've had to roll back our latest update promising impeccable precision in Doodle placement due to unforeseen bugs. We're diligently addressing these issues and aim to have you enjoying a seamless experience soon. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding as we fine-tune this exciting feature! 🚀🛠️ #DoodleUpdate #TechnicalMaintenance

notes.title: Enhanced Doodle Features and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
🚀 Exciting news, Steam gamers! We've just rolled out an update to improve your Doodle experience and fix a few pesky bugs. Check out the changes:

Sleek Doodle Display: The timer and doodle counter are now semi-transparent with a stylish hover effect for enhanced visibility.

Doodle Placement Precision: Say goodbye to overlapping doodles! Now, it's impossible to place two doodles in the same spot unless they're the perfect match.

Neat Pause Menu: The pause menu has been revamped to prevent it from memorizing positions, ensuring a clean and organized gaming experience.

Bug Squashing: We've fixed a bug where doodles could be moved even with the game paused. No more unintended doodle shuffling!

Enjoy an upgraded Steam experience with these fantastic improvements. Happy gaming! 🎮✨"
